body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 4 units. Remove Concussed, Dazed, or Shocked from it.

surges.html: One ally inside, warded by, or otherwise protected by this Rite gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
Once before this Rite ends, you may change one named target of the Rite to another eligible target.

rider.title: WARD RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The warded creature would suffer a normal Condition. Echo: Ignore that Condition.
